current_form.value: Captains Portugal at Al-Nassr; remains the most-capped player and leading scorer in men's international football (reported 143 goals from 226 caps). Finished as top scorer at the 2025 Nations League, which Portugal won.

fitness.value: Missed Portugal's March 2026 friendlies with a hamstring strain picked up at Al-Nassr, but named in the World Cup squad and expected to start (lead the line in Houston).

wc_role.value: Captained Portugal at a RECORD sixth World Cup, more than any man in tournament history (shares the previous joint-record of 5 with Lionel Messi, also at 2026). ELIMINATED in the Round of 16: Spain won 1-0 on Mikel Merino's 90+1' substitute winner (Dallas Stadium, 2026-07-06). Ronaldo had a first-half volley saved by Unai Simón; finished the tournament with 3 goals (brace vs Uzbekistan, penalty vs Croatia). Confirmed before the match this was his final World Cup — he retires from World Cups never having won one, still stuck on 4th-place-or-worse across six tournaments.

records.value: First man to play in six World Cups (record). Most-capped player and all-time leading scorer in men's international football (146 caps-goals tally cited post-WC2026). Won UEFA Euro 2016 and two UEFA Nations League titles; the World Cup is now a permanently missing major — his international career's last realistic shot at it ended 2026-07-06.
